subject: Barber Shop - Added to Waitlist
body:
Dear $customer_name,

You have been successfully added to our waitlist!

Waitlist Details:
- Service: $service_name
- Preferred Barber: $preferred_barber
- Position: $waitlist_position

We will notify you as soon as a suitable slot becomes available.

Thank you for your patience!

Best regards,
University Barber Shop
